description: This Java class defines and manages mapping strategies for the 'Things' service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides singleton access to a set of serialization/deserialization strategies for various Types used within the service, such as 'Thing' and 'ThingTag', and extends a base class 'MappingStrategies' to facilitate these mappings.

classes.name: ThingsMappingStrategies
classes.description: A final singleton class extending 'MappingStrategies' that holds and provides access to specific JSON serialization/deserialization strategies for 'Thing' related types within the Eclipse Ditto 'Things' service.

methods.name: ThingsMappingStrategies
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mapping strategies with specific mappings for 'Thing', 'ThingTag', and related entities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method implementing singleton pattern to provide a shared instance of 'ThingsMappingStrategies'.
